characteristic_complications: hyperviscosity syndrome (visual changes, headache, mucosal bleeding)

biomarkers.name: MYD88 L265P
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common supportive diagnostic feature in WM/LPL and helps distinguish from many cases of marginal zone lymphoma, but does not distinguish WM/LPL from IgM-MGUS because MYD88 L265P is also frequent in IgM-MGUS. MYD88-mutant disease is associated with better response to BTK inhibition than MYD88-wild-type disease

biomarkers.name: CXCR4 mutations (WHIM-like)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Predicts reduced/deeper delayed response to ibrutinib and other covalent BTK inhibitors; may influence regimen selection. Both nonsense and frameshift WHIM-like mutations are clinically relevant

biomarkers.name: Serum IgM
biomarkers.prevalence: Elevated in Waldenström macroglobulinaemia by definition
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnosis and response monitoring. Higher IgM level increases hyperviscosity risk, but no absolute threshold reliably predicts symptoms; hyperviscosity is more common at very high levels. Beware IgM flare with rituximab

biomarkers.name: Serum viscosity
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports assessment of hyperviscosity; symptoms may occur at variable levels, often when serum viscosity exceeds ~4 cP. Plasmapheresis is used for acute symptomatic management

biomarkers.name: Anti-MAG antibodies
biomarkers.prevalence: In a subset with IgM-associated demyelinating sensorimotor neuropathy
biomarkers.clinical_use: Explain sensory-predominant demyelinating neuropathy; specific IgM myelin-associated glycoprotein antibodies

biomarkers.name: IPSS-WM prognostic score
biomarkers.clinical_use: Age, β2M, Hb, platelets, IgM. Prognostic risk stratification

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Marrow infiltrate of small B lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein production; mast cells commonly increased
variants: Waldenström macroglobulinaemia (LPL with IgM paraprotein and BM involvement — most common)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: MYD88 L265P drives TLR-BTK signalling and is associated with BTK inhibitor sensitivity; CXCR4 mutations can blunt depth and speed of response
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow infiltration with mixed small lymphocyte/plasmacytoid/plasma cell morphology; increased mast cells characteristic

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Post-germinal centre B cells with plasmacytic differentiation and IgM paraprotein production; represents mixed maturation state along B-cell → plasma cell differentiation axis
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — lymphoid (post-germinal centre B cells and plasma cells)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Mixed small lymphocyte, plasmacytoid lymphocyte, and plasma cell population with IgM paraprotein production; represents captured intermediate on B-cell to plasma cell maturation axis; mast cells commonly increased
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: MYD88 L265P mutation (~90-95%) promotes NF-κB signalling and is associated with BTK inhibitor sensitivity; CXCR4 mutations blunt BTK inhibitor response (found in ~30-40%); represents lineage between mature B cell and plasma cell — mixed morphology reflects this differentiation state
